title: Chapter 447
paragraphs: Chapter 447
Episode 128. Zephyrin (3)
Murakan roared as he soared into the sky. The spaces filled with magic energy vibrated unstably due to his aura, and spirit energy seeped through the cracks.
It seemed like a giant black flame flickering. His sharp, pumpkin-colored eyes held the dignity fitting for a dragon that once ruled the sky.
As if she had been waiting for this moment, Zephyrin flashed a faint smile.
"Now I can feel a bit of your power!"
Kwaaaa...!
Murakan opened his dark mouth and blew out his breath. It was a sight filled with powerful spirit energy, incomparable to what he had fired before fully unleashing his strength.
Not only that, but black lines similar to breath poured from his wings and the curtains of spirit energy spread all around.
Dozens of black, matte lines bombarded the ground where Zephyrin stood.
Those lines were like a swamp. They cut and sliced with their nails, but they would still entangle Zephyrin again. It was like dozens of snakes entering one hole all at once.
'This is a battle between dragons.'
Balkas had seen other dragons fight several times in his life, but those battles felt fake compared to this one.

The battle unfolding before his eyes and the other dragon battles he had seen were not comparable. As with human martial artists and magicians, there was an insurmountable wall between the top dragons and ordinary ones.
However, even for someone who didn't know dragon battles well.
Zephyrin still held the advantage in power. She was still defending Murakan's attacks in place, not yet revealing her true form.
"We don't know how long Murakan can hold out, so we need to prepare to escape as soon as possible."
Jin sheathed Siegmund as he spoke.
He wanted to fight alongside Murakan if he could.
Just as Murakan was finally starting to reveal all his power, Jin and Balkas also
had plenty of untapped strength.
In particular, Jin still had the legacy of Lior Jifle, the magic sword technique of Sara, the King's Army of Van, and more. He had ultimate means that never lost their luster in any situation.
Murakan was sure they could 'never win', but if they used all their means, they might have a chance to beat that insane demon dragon.
However, the likelihood of that was extremely low, and Jin had no intention of risking his life here.
It was the right choice to conserve as much power as possible, break the void space, and escape with the entire Black King's unit.
Even if they used all their strength to defeat or severely injure Zephyrin, they would most likely die in the process.
They needed to escape somehow, find out Zephyrin's exact affiliation and purpose, and devise a means to counter her.
'How many more enemies of this level could there be?'
A new era had begun.
Lata Prochi had thought so since meeting Jin and often brought up stories about him while they were together.

Suddenly, Jin could empathize with that thought. After the Sword Emperor Star terror incident, Jin had been feeling that there were beings of different dimensions lurking everywhere among the enemies he had encountered so far.
Kinjelo, Gipl, and Biment.
Among the three forces, Biment could be considered somewhat weaker than Runkandel, but
Gipl was initially evaluated as superior to Runkandel, and Kinjelo revealed their full power during the Sword Emperor Star terror.
'Jephryn is probably affiliated with Kinjelo, and although there may not be many dragons or humans with this level of combat power among them, Jephryn is not everything.'
A candle in the wind.
Runkandel might not have known about this situation.
As far as Jin knew, Runkandel did not have any 'hidden power' like other forces. Of course, there were the black knights of Shiron and the former generation, but they were all bound to the black sea.
'Nevertheless, the only reason Runkandel has been able to remain intact so far is because of the existence of Father, Shiron Runkandel.'
He was convinced of it. The moment Shiron disappeared, Runkandel would inevitably follow the path of destruction.
'Mother's strong support for Joshua is also because she believes he has the means to confront these terrible enemies in the future.'
Crack! Shaaak!

Murakan's energy and Jephryn's fingernails continued to entangle chaotically. The dark lines became more intense, and the traces of the purple fingernails faded. It seemed like evidence that it was becoming harder to withstand in human form.
"I'll break through the space. Lord Balkas, please watch over the Black Knight."
"Understood, the 12th generation."
Swoosh...
The white blade of Bradamante slipped out of its sheath.
The shining blade was quickly dyed black with energy.
'I didn't expect to use this so soon again. I won't be able to use it for a while if I succeed.'
Before breaking through the space, Jin intended to open the door of Lafrarosa first.
Murakan was still easily holding off on his own, but once Jephryn revealed her true form, the situation would undoubtedly change.
As long as this space was not a 'dead space' like that of Solderet, there would be no obstacle to unfolding the black light summon.
Swish!
The black-dyed blade drew in the air.
'Thankfully...!'
The moment he swung his sword, he felt it. The feeling that the door of Lafrarosa was opening.
If there was any disappointment, it was that what rushed out of the newly formed dark door was not the Two Kings but an ordinary warrior.
"Oh, it's me this time!"
The bright and cheerful King's Tribe member who appeared was Shaku.

Jin received the recognition of all twelve Tukings in Lafrarosa, and became a true brother after having the most duels with the Myungwang tribesman. At that time, Jin had fought over fifty times and won victories against this individual.
"I'm sorry for calling you, Shaku brother."
"No, it's an honor to fight for my brother. What do you want?"
Shaku said, placing his thunderbolt-infused longsword on his back. Before the Myungwang tribe perished, the title 'Thunderbolt Shaku' was attached to his name.
"Help that guy."
"I see, I roughly understand the situation. Do we need to break through here and go out to support?"
"Yes."
Shaku's gaze landed on Jephirin, who was trapped by the black lines.

"A demon, no, a demon dragon? It's been a long time since I've encountered such dreadful demonic energy. It should have been the Tuking brothers who were summoned instead. Hurry and escape, I'll do my best to hold them back with the Black Dragon."
As Shaku joined the battle, thunderbolt energy mingled with the spirit and demonic energy once again. Shaku didn't lose his energy even amidst the swirling spirit and demonic energy.
Although he was an ordinary warrior, a Myungwang tribesman was still a Myungwang tribesman. Their unique strong physique shone especially brightly in this melee.

Seeing this, Balkas couldn't help but be surprised once more. Although he had already experienced Jin summoning ancient combat masters at Geomhwangseong, it was still unfamiliar and amazing to see again.
He also had a similar thought to Lata Prochi.
'No matter who Jephirin belongs to, and whatever the reason, the fact that they're causing trouble in Heukwangsan like this... There may no longer be room for neutrality in this world.'
Circumstantially, it was clear that Jephirin had reacted upon seeing Jin and Murakan.
However, it was not something they could blame Jin for afterward.
Since the riders and black knights of Runecandle had unexpectedly come to Heukwangsan and got entangled in danger, it was rather Jin or Joshua's position to blame.
'First of all, I must escape with the 12th Rider and my subordinates. Even if it means abandoning Heukwangsan!'
Balkas thought, gritting his teeth.
And strangely, Balkas felt an inexplicable sense of trust. As always, Jin Runecandle, the 12th Rider, would achieve what he wanted this time as well.
'It's the first time I've felt this kind of trust in someone who is less skilled than me after reaching the 10th rank.'
Hwarururu!
Blue flames began to form on the blackened blade of Bradamante.
Although Tess was still recovering and couldn't respond to the summoning directly, the power of weight he had engraved on Bradamante was growing stronger with Jin.
The blue flames that spread from the sword began to suppress the demonic energy-infused space.
The trembling spaces under the power of weight seemed to be devoured by fear like a person. The unwavering blade was slowly preparing to cut through the space.
It was at that moment that Jephilin, who had been holding her ground against Murakan and Shaku's attacks, finally reacted.
"Blue fire! Bringing such transcendent power into a fight among the lower beings is cheating, 12th Knight."
As it was when Murakan and Quicantel first encountered Tes.
Jephilin was also afraid of Tes's power. She knew the kind of prestige Tes held in the realm of flames.
That's why, even though the blue fire controlled by Jin was incomparable to the true power of Tes, Jephilin felt an instinctive fear. It felt as if she was suffocating.
That fear could only be felt by those who had directly witnessed the 'Master of the Flame Realm.'
Woosh, crackle!
Whether it was because her attention was momentarily drawn to the blue fire, or because she had reached the limits of the martial prowess she could display in human form.
Jephilin's defense, which had been holding up well, was finally penetrated. Murakan's spirit energy and Shaku's lightning engulfed her, tearing her body apart.
Even as her body was ripped apart and disintegrated, Jephilin did not scream once.
Instead of blood, particles of purple magic scattered in all directions, followed by a long, ominous laugh that echoed through the air.
Ahahaha... Haha, ha...!
As the sinister laughter subsided, an enormous cloud of purple smoke formed from the space where Jephilin had been torn apart.
The smoke was several times larger than Murakan.
And hidden within the smoke was Jephilin's true form. So huge that it looked like an entire mountain was moving, making Murakan look small in comparison.
Jephilin, visible intermittently through the smoke, had a form closer to a 'snake' rather than the dragons typically known by the saints.
[Ah, really. Seeing that blue flame makes me feel uneasy and I don't like it. Turn it off before I get angry, and wait quietly.]
Jephilin revealed her head from the smoke and spoke.

Jin did not respond to her words and continued to focus his mind. Just as when he had opened the gates of Muelon's hell, he had to simultaneously wield the first technique of the spirit sword and Tes's power to open the space in a single attempt.
Crackle!
As Jephilin was about to say something else, Murakan flew in like an arrow and stabbed her pupil with his claw.
However, her pupil did not suffer any damage, and instead, it was Murakan who was bounced away by the counterforce.
[Ah, damn! Why is it so hard?]
Murakan yelled as he regained his posture in midair.
Instead of reacting to Murakan, Jephilin prepared to unleash her breath at Jin.
